One table, 1 file or 30. Area is a dropdown pre-filled with the AI's pick (one-tap correct). "preview" shows source-column → canonical-field mapping with citations. Steward (the Setup agent) adds open-ended validation flags inline — conflicts, realism, implied gaps — each a one-tap confirm/correct. A file it can't resolve inline routes to ask Steward (Screen 7). Primary button: Answer N questions → Confirm & load 12.

Screen 4 · Clarify (only the low-confidence ones, batched)

Financials ▾Skip this file

Mapping questions only — never "supply the missing number." Best guess pre-selected. Skipping leaves a file un-ingested (no half-commit).

Screen 6 · Azure Storage (IT exception — direct-to-Blob)

Use your own tools

Prefer Azure Storage Explorer or azcopy? Upload straight to your governed landing zone — we'll ingest it the same way.

landing/meridian-health/inbox/Open in Azure Storage ExplorerCopy azcopy command
3 new files detected in your landing zone
Review & ingest
Same pipeline, different on-ramp. Because the bytes are already in Blob, Gate 0 (preservation) is satisfied by construction. Files flow into the same "Here's what I found" review (Screen 3). Auto-pickup via Event Grid also supported; this button is the manual "process one time."

Screen 7 · Ask Steward (scoped dock — the escalation path)

Q3_board.pptx

Parsed preview · 18 slides · tables on 4, 9, 12

Slide 9 · "FY26 Financial Plan" Net revenue 11.2B · Op margin 1.8%→4.0% IT transformation $84M · …
Ask Steward · scoped to this file
Steward: This looks like a board strategy deck — mostly Financials + some Initiatives/Roadmap. The slide-9 table reads as financial baseline. Load it as Financials, and pull the roadmap items into Initiatives?
You: yes — and the $84M is the IT transformation program, not run-rate.
Steward: Got it — mapping $84M → initiative.budget (program), not spend.run_rate. 12 facts ready, each cited to its slide. Confirm?
Confirm mappingBack to review
Escalation, not the front door. Opens only when a file can't be resolved by an inline flag (multi-step ambiguity, a conflict, or you tap "ask Steward"). Scoped to one file, carries its parsed preview, writes the resolved mapping back into Screen 3. Anthropic-only; the whole exchange is saved as provenance ("how this fact came to be"); document facts still go through review. Most uploads never reach this screen.

Wireframe only — low fidelity, for workflow review. Visual system is the locked AbarVa design language; final UI inherits the production component library. Spec: UX_WORKFLOW.md.
